paper_title: VideoLLaMB Long-context Video Understanding with Recurrent Memory   Bridges
caption: GPU Memory Cost. We apply all the experiments on a single NVIDIA A800 GPU.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the GPU memory cost in GB for various models as the number of frames increases. The y-axis, labeled "Memory (GB)", has a linear scale with a range of 0 to 400 GB and tick labels at regular intervals of 50 GB. The x-axis, labeled "Number of Frames", has a linear scale with a range of 0 to 1000 and tick labels at intervals of 200. The plot features five lines, each representing a different model: VideoLLaMB (pink, no marker), VideoLLaMB-R (brown, no marker), PLLAVA (green, no marker), LLaVA-NeXT (blue, circle markers), and VideoLLAVA (purple, circle markers). The VideoLLaMB line starts at approximately 10 GB and increases steadily to around 410 GB at 1000 frames. The VideoLLaMB-R line remains relatively flat, starting at about 5 GB and reaching around 30 GB at 1000 frames. The PLLAVA line starts at approximately 5 GB and increases to around 80 GB at 1000 frames. The LLaVA-NeXT line begins at about 10 GB and rises to approximately 130 GB at 1000 frames. The VideoLLAVA line starts at around 30 GB and sharply increases to about 410 GB at 1000 frames.
